name: Losing Time
source:
A game about a girl who's really not sure where she fits in. Maybe because she doesn't belong in a place or a time, but with a person.

[From [url=https://letrickster.itch.io/losing-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款关于一个女孩的游戏，她真的不确定自己适合哪里。也许是因为她不属于某个地方或某个时间，而是属于一个人。

[来自[url=https://letrickster.itch.io/losing-time]Itch.io[/url]]
